sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's fmap over Nothing — applying a transformation to an absent value silently propagates the absence
sketches.resonance: No matter what you try to become, if you were never there, the becoming simply doesn't happen.
sketches.draft:
become :: a -> b
become = undefined

hope :: Maybe a
hope = fmap become Nothing

sketches.mechanism: A goroutine sent into a channel that no one receives from blocks forever, and when main exits, it is silently discarded
sketches.resonance: A voice speaking into a channel no one listens to is not an error — it is simply forgotten.

sketches.mechanism: A self LEFT JOIN where the join condition can never match produces the original row paired with all NULLs — you exist beside your own absence
sketches.resonance: When you try to meet yourself and the condition is never right, you sit across from nothing.
